verdict_note: Read-only code-check and red-team of eb17fad6..945406d9 (8 commits, 5 files). No build break found and the rebase is textually clean. One lost write is reachable from the new rows (F1): an edit the decoder will not read back is committed. One preset round trip silently drops what save_preset wrote (F2). The DNG receipt claims a crop it did not apply when there is no preview (F3). The export-stage size is computed for the uncropped frame (F4). F1 and F2 are fixes inside owned paths (develop.rs, develop_more.rs) with one red test each. F3 and F4 are one line each in develop.rs. The doc_export.rs develop_crop_not_applied note under the lead ruling is not in 945406d9 yet (lead_questions Q3).

findings.severity: lost write (whole develop edit replaced by identity on the next op and on reopen)
findings.where: harness-view src/view/develop.rs:530-545 (AddCorrection / AddMask push any brush source; the only dab check is per brush, :575, AddBrushDabs) and :1337 (encode_state, then commit, no read-back); develop_entry.rs:611-612 and :417 (decoder: ONE MAX_DABS budget across the whole edit's local corrections); develop/src/local.rs:280 (develop validates MAX_DABS per brush only); new rows commands/photo.rs:256-257 (add_correction / add_mask, brush dabs up to MAX_DABS per call, :120)
findings.what: The writer and the reader disagree on the dab limit. Develop validation and the viewer allow MAX_DABS (65536) dabs per brush. The entry decoder allows MAX_DABS in total across every brush of the edit. So develop_change commits an entry that develop_entry::decode refuses on its next read. DevelopDoc::entry then caches Refused(develop_entry_limit) and status_state returns identity() for it (develop.rs status_state, Refused arm). The next develop op starts from identity, and the commit overwrites every adjustment, correction, override, crop and snapshot. Reopen starts from the file recipe. Before this lane only the Rust API could reach this. The new add_correction and add_mask rows put it on the command surface.
findings.scenario: photo.develop.add_correction {source: brush, dabs: [40000 x [0.4,0.35]]} then the same again (each brush is <= 65536, the entry is about 0.9 MB, under the 8 MiB cap). Both return Ok with a revision. develop_json.entry is now Refused(develop_entry_limit) and values_known is false. Then photo.develop.set {develop.exposure: 0.3}: the edit is identity plus exposure, and the two corrections, all sliders and all snapshots are gone in that undo step. Save and reopen lose the edit as well.
findings.fix: In develop_change, after encode_state, run develop_entry::decode(&bytes) and require Ok, with the decoded state equal to the state being written. Otherwise refuse (develop_limit or the decoder's code) before staging tiles. This one round-trip guard also covers any future writer/reader asymmetry, including snapshots. Also add a whole-edit dab sum check in DevelopOp::apply_edit next to the MAX_CORRECTIONS check (:633), so the refusal is develop_limit with a clear message. Red test: two brush corrections of 40000 dabs each through the row. Expect a typed refusal on the second call, the entry still Current, and undo_len unchanged.

findings.severity: wrong answer (a preset setting silently dropped; the row reports success)
findings.where: harness-view src/view/develop_more.rs:230-238 (FamilyOp::Preset applies the preset to a scratch recipe, then keeps only exposure_stops and adjust); develop/src/preset.rs:236-251 (enable.* keys write recipe.enables) and :308 (enable.* are preset keys); develop.rs save_develop_preset (capture from d.recipe(..), whose enables include this lane's overrides)
findings.what: save_preset accepts enable.<group> keys and writes the current group enables, including STU-RAW-105 overrides. photo.develop.apply_preset (a new row from this lane) runs DevelopPreset::apply on a scratch recipe, then copies back only adjust and exposure. Every enable.* setting the preset holds is dropped, and the row still returns Ok with a revision. This breaks the lane's own V4-06 rule: a member a reader cannot honour is a typed refusal or a named note, never silently dropped.
findings.scenario: photo.develop.set_enable {group: detail, on: false}. Then save_preset {keys: ["enable.detail", "contrast"]} writes 'set enable.detail false'. On another frame, apply_preset {amount: 1} returns Ok: contrast applies, detail stays on, and develop_json.enables_override is empty.
findings.fix: The Preset arm cannot reach the extras, because it gets only (Adjustments, exposure). Handle it in DevelopOp::apply (develop.rs), which receives DevelopState. For DevelopOp::Family(FamilyOp::Preset) with amount > 0, map each enable.<group> setting of the parsed preset into state.extras.enables_override after the adjust part is applied. Or refuse such a preset with a typed code (preset_enable_not_applied). Lead choice, see Q2. Red test: the scenario above.

findings.where: harness-view src/view/develop.rs:1446 (develop_crop.applied_to is always "preview"); develop/src/dng_write.rs:699-702 (DngPreview::None writes no preview and renders nothing)
findings.what: On a DNG export with preview None the stored crop is applied nowhere: the raw frame is whole, no preview is rendered, and the XMP does not carry it. The receipt still says develop_crop {applied_to: "preview"}.
findings.scenario: set_crop {0.1, 0.2, 0.9, 0.8}, then export_develop(path, DevelopExport::Dng {preview: DngPreview::None, ..}). The receipt has preview null and develop_crop.applied_to "preview".
findings.fix: Use applied_to: if export.preview.is_some() { "preview" } else { "none" }. In the none case add the note develop_crop_not_applied next to develop_crop_not_in_dng_xmp. Extend the crop test with one preview-None DNG export.

findings.certainty: READ (sizes); UNVERIFIED (which stage settings flip ready() to a refusal)
findings.severity: wrong answer in develop_json.export_stage, and a possible false refusal or acceptance of a staged export
findings.where: harness-view src/view/develop.rs:1245 (develop_json export_stage), :1403 (d.export.ready(..) before PNG/JPEG/TIFF), :1719 (staged_ok); src/view/develop/export_dialog.rs:588-590 (develop_export_source_size = the uncropped prepared.window) and :395 (fit_output_size(size))
findings.what: The develop export now crops: develop_to_image_threads cuts crop.source_bounds of the window. The export-stage precheck and the state projection still size the stage against the uncropped window. develop_json.export_stage reports an output size the export will not produce, and ready() checks the stage against the wrong source. This is a V4-06 reader of the recipe that ignores the new crop member, and the lane file's failure-class sweep does not list it.
findings.scenario: Export stage on with long edge 2000 and 'do not enlarge' on a 2400 px wide frame cropped to 0.25..0.75. develop_json.export_stage predicts 2000 px. The export develops a 1200 px crop and the stage then decides on 1200.
findings.fix: In develop.rs only (owned): one helper returns the crop's source_bounds extent on (window.width, window.height), or the window when the crop is full. Pass it to d.export.json, d.export.ready and staged_ok instead of develop_export_source_size(). The tiny-crop case is safe, because source_bounds floors and ceils to at least 1 px. Add one assert to the crop test: develop_json.export_stage size equals the exported width and height.

lead_questions.Q1_preset_save_jobport: The common ruling says every export is admitted through the Viewer's bound JobPort before its first byte (as_export_job, layout_export.rs:543). save_develop_preset writes through write_new/write_atomic without admission, as export_develop does today. Is a preset save an 'export' for this ruling (one as_export_job wrap in develop.rs), or out of scope like the unadmitted export_develop?
lead_questions.Q2_preset_enables: F2: should apply_preset map enable.* preset keys into the STU-RAW-105 overrides (enables_override, one undo step with the adjust part), or refuse them with a typed code? Mapping keeps STU-RAW-128 'records which parameters it sets' honest; refusing is smaller.
lead_questions.Q3_doc_export_note: The PATH APPROVED doc_export.rs develop_crop_not_applied note and its red test are not in 945406d9. The lane file's failure_class_sweep still says 'no receipt note there (doc_export.rs outside owned paths)', and notes.beyond_brief_paths is absent. Both must change with that commit, per the 2026-11-11 waiver-audit rule. Confirm it lands before the bundled run, so the run proves it.
lead_questions.Q4_F1_scope: F1 also exists in the pre-lane Rust API (DevelopOp::AddCorrection with a brush, AddBrushDabs per-brush check). The guard sits in develop.rs (owned) and protects every develop op. Confirm that fixing it here is in scope, and not routed to a separate lane.

checked: Full diff eb17fad6..945406d9, every hunk of the 5 files: harness-core action/commands/photo.rs; harness-view view/commands/photo.rs, view/develop.rs, view/develop_entry.rs; harness tests/viewer_develop_commands.rs.

Decoders: every new row through Fields (decode.rs). Missing keys give parameter_missing and extra keys give parameter_unknown (commands.rs check_declared). Wrong type and non-finite values (including 'inf'/'NaN' text) give parameter_invalid. Mask fields of another source are refused, never dropped. List counts are checked before item decode (bounded: colours, dabs, guides, points, changes <= 4096). File parameters are read with read_bounded under MAX_CUBE_BYTES, MAX_PRESET_BYTES and MAX_LENS_PROFILE_BYTES. Unicode in names: check_name (<= 256 bytes, no control char, no outer Unicode whitespace) on write, 256-byte text cap on decode.

set_many: atomic. set_develop_many applies every pair in one develop_change and any unknown control refuses before commit, giving one undo step. Duplicate JSON keys collapse to the last value in serde (no lost write).

Group enables: absent override means derived (develop.rs recipe(), overrides applied after derivation). Default extras give identity curves and full crop, equal to DevelopRecipe::native (dng.rs recipe_from_solution), so existing documents develop the same recipe. encode_extras writes nothing for defaults, so old entries keep their bytes. red_eye on is refused by Enables::first_unsupported. All 11 other enables gate an engine stage (adjust.rs:210-218, geometry.rs:481-482, recipe.rs:315/337).

Point curves: Curve::new (curves.rs:23) enforces 2..32 points, finite values in 0..255, endpoints (0,0)/(255,255), strictly ascending x (duplicate x refused) and nondecreasing y. MAX_POINTS is checked in the row decoder, RecipeOp::apply and the entry decoder.

Snapshots: at most 64 on write and decode. Duplicate names are refused on write (develop_snapshot_exists) and on decode. Nested snapshots are refused. Save, apply and delete are each one entry-only undo step (develop_change commits even when no tile moved). Undo restores a deleted snapshot (test). The 8 MiB cap is enforced in encode_state, so an oversized snapshot set is a typed refusal before commit.

save_preset: refuses an empty path or the opened source (is_source canonicalizes, and does so whatever overwrite says), validates the name and 1..=4096 keys, then capture, to_text and a parse read-back. write_new is no-clobber (hard link, AlreadyExists gives destination_exists), and overwrite uses write_atomic. Drive typed() adds same_file and overwrite_required for OUTPUT_PATH params. Row mutates_authority false matches the code (document unchanged).

Windows name equivalence for save_preset: is_source and the no-clobber check both go through Win32 path normalization (canonicalize / symlink_metadata / hard_link). So a trailing dot or space and a case difference resolve to the same file, giving export_over_source or destination_exists. Reserved device names fall through to export_write without replacing any file (write_new error arms remove only its own temp or reservation).

Crop: NormalizedCrop::validate (recipe.rs:121) bounds angle to -45..45, edges to 0..1, left < right and top < bottom. Non-finite values are refused. A crop larger than the image cannot be stated, and a zero-size crop is EmptyCrop. source_bounds floors and ceils, so the smallest crop is 1 px. The canvas develops preview_recipe (crop stripped, validated with the crop first). PNG, JPEG and TIFF go through develop_to_image_threads (geometry_stage for angle and flips). The DNG preview goes through develop_to_output. Receipts carry develop_crop (F3 for DNG without a preview).

photo.info: every one of the 7 InfoCommand arms writes the info entry through set_tiles_and_entry as one step (info.rs:378-412). Samplers are persistent document state under STU-RAS-163. Declaring mutates_authority true matches the R60 attempt_2_probes repair_direction for r60_c9. Consumers of the flag (drive.rs:307 undo_name, manual, corpus json, motion_commands) are unaffected otherwise.

Lane-file claims against code: rows, overrides, curves, crop at export, snapshots <= 64, preset save no-clobber, absent-by-default entry members and the photo.info item are all backed by code. Sweep gaps: doc_export (Q3) and the export-stage size (F4) are missing. The DNG claim 'applied to preview' does not hold for preview None (F3).

Test sweep interplay: harness_drive_typed every_typed_row_of_the_manual_declares_its_parameters_and_refuses_by_type covers the new rows. check_declared runs before the drive's OUTPUT_PATH guard can refuse, because no 'path' is given in that sweep.
